notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: Third consecutive run against this source with the same outcome — confirms 2026-09-19 and 2026-09-21 findings rather than surfacing anything new. Braintrust currently has almost no SRE/Platform/DevOps-specific demand for the target titles; worth deprioritizing this source's checking frequency relative to higher-yield boards until the skill-chip inventory turns over.

No CAPTCHA, verification prompt, or write-side action occurred; no account created, no profile submitted, no sign-in.

Checked applications.md fresh this run: TaskRabbit (https://app.usebraintrust.com/jobs/17859/) is Applied — 2026-09-19; United States Cold Storage is Skipped — 2026-09-21 (Ineligible, US-only). Both statuses carried forward, neither re-scored nor re-filed.
